headline: BMW Cuts 2026 Profit Margin Outlook Amid Portfolio Changes
summary: German automaker BMW has lowered its profit margin outlook for the 2026 financial year, citing ongoing adjustments to its vehicle portfolio.
why: BMW is a major global automotive manufacturer whose profit margins signal broader demand trends and cost pressures within the premium vehicle sector.

impacts.name: BMW
impacts.why: A lowered margin outlook directly points to reduced expected profitability for the firm.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A reduction in projected profit margins directly disappoints earnings expectations, triggering downward pressure on the company's shares.
